name: @gajaeway/cli
description: Owner CLI for the gajaeway gateway: status, sessions, chat, monitors, and worker lanes over the gateway socket. Requires the Bun runtime (uses Bun.file/Bun.spawn).
author: Yeachan Heo

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @gajaeway/protocol --external @gajaeway/sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
